possession.modeDuoMeta: Taking turns, or each on your own phone
possession.relaisDebut: Answer all the questions, then pass the phone.
possession.relaisSuite: {{nom}} is done. Your turn, no peeking at their answers!
possession.verdictEquivalent: Two different answers, the same fate.
possession.ecartsTitre: Where you didn't react the same way
possession.modesDesc: Fifteen questions about your curiosity, your sleep and your relationship with old houses. Solo, you find out your risk. As a couple, each of you answers separately, and we find out who opens the door to the demons.
possession.modeSoloDesc: Fifteen questions, a risk in percent.
possession.modeDuoDesc: Taking turns on the same phone, or each on your own with remote mode.
possession.setupDescSolo: Fifteen questions about your curiosity, your nights and how you react when a door slams on its own. The result is a possession risk in percent, with what protects you and what exposes you.
possession.setupTitreDuo: Which of you could get possessed?
possession.setupDescDuo: Enter your first names. The first player answers the fifteen questions, passes the phone, and the second answers in turn. At the end, your two risks side by side, and the name of the one the demons would choose.
possession.duoPerd: {{nom}} is the one who gets possessed, at {{vp}}. {{autre}} gets away with {{va}}.
possession.duoEgal: Same risk for both of you: {{v1}}. The demon will have to choose.
possession.verdictDifferent: {{nom}} opens the door a little wider.
possession.noteFin: A Halloween quiz, just for fun. No demons were consulted in writing it.
possession.r1_d: You lock the doors, you refuse Ouija boards, you sleep with the duvet up to your chin. Demons move on: too much work for too little.
possession.r1_a: Keep it up. And keep a bit of salt on you, for the others.
possession.r2_d: You have the right reflexes, but you can't help looking. A demon would really have to work to get in, and it has other houses to visit.
possession.r2_a: Avoid filming doors that slam. Close them.
possession.r3_d: On a normal day, you're fine. On a tired night, in an old house, with a Ouija board lying around... that's debatable.
possession.r3_a: Sleep well, especially in October. And leave the board in the attic.
possession.r4_d: You talk to mirrors, you go downstairs when the voice calls you, and you bring home flea-market finds without asking questions. Demons pass your address around.
possession.r4_a: Before buying an old object, at least ask where it comes from.
possession.r5_d: Honestly, we wonder whether it's you taking this quiz or whether something is doing it in your place. You open every door, you say yes to everything, and you find it funny.
possession.r5_a: If your eyes turn completely black while reading this result, let someone know.
possession.q1_sur: A Ouija board is lying around in the attic of the rented house.
possession.q1a: We're playing tonight, what a vibe!
possession.q1b: I look at it from a distance, curious
possession.q1c: I put it away without touching it
possession.q1d: I burn it in the garden
possession.q2a: Arms spread wide, window open, lights off
possession.q2b: With one foot sticking out of the duvet
possession.q2c: On my side, a night light on
possession.q2d: Door locked, duvet up to my chin
possession.q3_sur: Someone tells you: “This house is haunted.”
possession.q3b: “So they say, but I don't really believe it.”
possession.q4: When you're scared at night, you...
possession.q4a: I say out loud “if anyone's there, show yourself”
possession.q4b: I tell myself it's the wind and go back to sleep
possession.q4c: I pull the duvet over my head
possession.q5a: I love them, I bring them home from flea markets without asking anything
possession.q5b: I find them beautiful, from a distance
possession.q5c: I like them, but I always ask where they come from
possession.q5d: Nothing old in my home, ever
possession.q6_sur: A priest offers you a blessing “just in case”.
possession.q6b: I take the bottle of holy water for later
possession.q6c: I ask first what it involves
possession.q7: When a door slams on its own, you...
possession.q7a: I go see why, asking “is that you?”
possession.q7b: I film it for social media
possession.q7c: I close the window, it's a draught
possession.q7d: I say “not tonight” out loud and leave
possession.q8a: I watch them alone, at night, lights off
possession.q8b: With someone, and I sleep badly afterwards
possession.q9_sur: The old mirror in the bedroom has a stain that looks like a face.
possession.q9a: I stare at it for a long time to see if it moves
possession.q9b: I take a photo of the stain
possession.q9c: I sleep with my back to it
possession.q9d: I cover it with a sheet
possession.q10b: Big, but I know when to stop
possession.q10c: Average, I'd rather be told about it
possession.q11a: At rock bottom, everything happens to me
possession.q11d: On top, nothing gets to me
possession.q12_sur: In an abandoned church, a statue is looking at you.
possession.q12b: I get closer to touch it
possession.q12c: I take the photo and leave
possession.q13b: Slept in a cemetery, for a laugh
possession.q13c: Visited a haunted house, in a group
possession.q13d: None of that, and I intend to keep it that way
possession.q14_sur: A voice whispers to you to come down to the basement.
possession.q14a: I go down, it sounded nice
possession.q14b: I ask it what it wants
possession.q14c: I put my earphones in, very loud
possession.q14d: I leave the house and put it up for sale
possession.q15c: I don't believe in anything, so nothing can reach me... normally
possession.q15d: I'm stubborn: nobody will make me do anything
